keys.name: Name
keys.summary: The component's own name, whether an operator typed it or the platform minted it.

keys.name: Ordinal
keys.summary: The number the component's NAME carries, and empty when it carries none: an operator named the row, or the mint suppressed the first of its stem in the bucket (ADR-0101). Empty is falsy, so {{if .Ordinal}} is the whole of the suppression rule a rule author writes.

keys.name: TypeName
keys.summary: The label of the component_type the product classifies it as, resolved over an operator's fork of a shipped row.

keys.name: TypeAbbrev
keys.summary: The abbreviation inherited down the component_type chain, first non-null wins.

keys.name: Stem
keys.summary: The naming stem inherited down the component_type chain, the token generated names are built from.

keys.name: VendorName
keys.summary: The vendor's label, empty when the product names no vendor.

keys.name: LocationLabel
keys.summary: How the location this component sits AT reads: the label an operator typed or the platform rendered, else that location's own name. It is the row's own location, never an ancestor's and never its plane root's, so a nested component with no location of its own reads it as absent.

keys.name: SystemTypeLabel
keys.summary: The label of the type of the system this component is a PRIMARY member of, empty when it is a member of none.

keys.name: Name
keys.summary: The system's own name, whether an operator typed it or the platform minted it.

keys.name: Ordinal
keys.summary: The number the system's NAME carries, and empty when it carries none, so the two halves of a divisible boardroom read as the name shows them (ADR-0101).

keys.name: TypeName
keys.summary: The label of the system_type it is classified as.

keys.name: TypeAbbrev
keys.summary: The abbreviation inherited down the system_type chain, first non-null wins.

keys.name: Stem
keys.summary: The naming stem inherited down the system_type chain.

keys.name: StandardName
keys.summary: The label of the standard it conforms to, empty when it conforms to none.
